references.observed: Irregular reddish brown bars on cream skin, long separated dorsal spines, spotted fan-like pectorals and head appendages.

references.use: Primary diagnosis: thirteen dorsal spines, separated elongated spines and head tentacles.
NOAA archived comparative development paper Table 4: thirteen dorsal spines and fourteen pectoral rays for the selected visual form.

limitations: Original Pterois volitans visual study, not a scan or measured specimen. Thirteen dorsal spines and fourteen pectoral rays per flank follow NOAA references; fine dermal appendages are simplified. Reference photos are not textures.
